packageRules.description: pnpm majors change install/lockfile semantics for the whole workspace at once (packageManager pins the exact version, currently 11.x); hold them for a deliberate toolchain upgrade rather than a bot PR
Resolve github.com/google/uuid through the public Go module proxy. This avoids the hosted no-result lookup while keeping Renovate checks and future updates enabled.

Match pnpm 11's own default 24-hour minimumReleaseAge install-time policy (pnpm-workspace.yaml). Without this, Renovate can open and auto-merge an npm bump for a package published hours ago, landing a lockfile entry that pnpm itself then rejects on the very next install (#1345/#1391) — a same-day-published version cleared pnpm's own gate only because #964-era exclusions predate this repo pinning pnpm 11.
